posts.text: Q1 FY27 was strong, with revenue at ~₹732 Cr and EBITDA at ~₹95 Cr. The important point for me is that EBITDA/tonne has improved materially, while margins have remained around 13%. I don’t want to simply annualise Q1 and assume ₹225 Cr+ PAT for FY27. I think a more reasonable base case is ₹170–180 Cr PAT in FY27. The bigger story, in my view, is FY28. The stainless-steel expansion at Kesda is expected to start contributing from FY28. If commissioning happens on schedule and utilisation ramps up reasonably, I think revenue can move towards ₹3,500–3,800 Cr, with PAT potentially reaching ₹250–280…
